# Patterns for class files that must remain duplicated in each Spark-version
# directory even when binary dedupe marks them bitwise-identical.
#
# Add entries only when a class must be loaded from the selected shim directory
# and needs same-loader visibility to other shim-only classes. New common
# classes should normally stay unshimmed by default.

# These shim rule containers are inherited by SparkShimImpl and instantiate
# shim-only rule metadata. Keeping them in each selected shim directory avoids
# loading a shared parent trait from a classloader that cannot see its shim-only
# dependencies.
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/AnsiCastRuleShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/AggregateInPandasExecShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/Spark*PlusShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/Spark*PlusNonDBShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/Spark*PlusDBShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/RoundingShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/MapInPandasExecShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/PythonMapInArrowExecShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/RangeExecShims*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/shims/ScanExecShims*.class

# These aggregate families have shim-local abstract bases or concrete implementations.
# Keep bases, companions, and concrete implementations in the same selected shim loader.
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/aggregate/Gpu*Average*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/aggregate/Gpu*Sum*.class

# These arithmetic families have version-specific concrete classes and common bases.
# Keep the bases, helpers, companions, and concrete implementations together.
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuAdd*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuSubtract*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuMultiply*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuDivModLike*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuDivide*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuIntegralDivide*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuDecimalDivide*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuRemainder*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuPmod*.class

org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuBitwiseAnd*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuBitwiseOr*.class
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/GpuBitwiseXor*.class

# Project exec has a shim-local Like trait; keep its companion with that trait so
# extractor pattern matching resolves in the selected shim loader.
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/GpuProjectExecLike*.class

# Broadcast exchange has a shim-local base; keep the base, companion, and
# concrete implementation together in the selected shim loader.
org/apache/spark/sql/rapids/execution/GpuBroadcastExchangeExec*.class

# Transition rule bytecode has generated helpers that pattern-match shim-local GPU
# exchange execs. Keep the rule and helpers in the selected shim loader.
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/GpuTransitionOverrides.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/GpuTransitionOverrides$$*.class
